responsibility: Defines shared THIR helper functionality for recovering user-annotated types from typeck results, especially mapping recorded user type annotations onto the concrete ADT or function item referred to by a HIR node.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `build/matches/util.rs`, which contains MIR match-lowering CFG and fake-borrow helpers, this `util.rs` is a small THIR-side abstraction for recovering and normalizing user-provided type annotations from type checking results.
